recovered_historical_reference.excluded_bad_plants_evidence: Historical excluded_bad_plants.csv stores train/val/test counts for 12 plants rejected because validation or test rows exceeded train rows.

current_4way_extension.rationale: Calibration is a current selection partition. The recovered non-Train<=Train rule is applied to Validation, Calibration, and Test under one global calendar boundary set; no per-plant cutoff or invented minimum-N threshold is allowed.

decision_semantics.ADMITTED: Passes the frozen recovered relational rules in eligibility.v2. Model-specific usable sample counts are checked later by forecast readiness.
decision_semantics.REJECT: Fails one or more frozen structural/relational rules. The source/service population remains preserved.
decision_semantics.HOLD: Reserved for future policy states requiring explicit human review; frozen relational v2 should normally emit no HOLD decisions.

notes: No fixed minimum N per split is introduced because no versioned evidence for such a historical rule was found.
Main benchmark splitting is global-calendar, not per-plant percentage splitting. Every admitted plant receives the same Train/Validation/Calibration/Test timestamp boundaries.
Different plant history lengths may produce different realized split ratios; this does not change the common classification rule.
A short-history plant is excluded from the main cohort or reported separately; its Test window must not be moved to manufacture a desired percentage.

If current local Gold cannot support the canonical boundaries, revise and version one global boundary set before training. Never choose plant-specific boundaries or revise after inspecting Test performance.
The admission policy filters only the AI model population. EPSIS nationwide service inventory is not filtered by model eligibility.
After this population gate, forecast_readiness remains responsible for model-specific lookback/horizon and effective sample losses.
